notes: RSS_DATABASE_URL은 실행 환경에서 별도 지정한다. /src는 소스, /build/before와 /build/release는 전후 실행 파일 디렉터리다. 스크립트는 Python 3과 Linux taskset, tcpdump를 사용한다. 각 조건을 순서대로 실행하고 다른 빌드·테스트와 겹치지 않는다.

import subprocess,os,time,json,signal,sys,hashlib,pathlib,resource
label,variant,scenario=sys.argv[1:4]
root=pathlib.Path('/src/build/nodelay')/label;root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
bindir=pathlib.Path('/build/before' if variant=='before' else '/build/release')
env=os.environ.copy();env['RSS_DATABASE_URL']=os.environ['RSS_DATABASE_URL'];env['RSS_OBSERVABILITY_INTERVAL_SECONDS']='10'
server_cmd=['taskset','-c','0,1',str(bindir/'rss_server'),'127.0.0.1','19090','2']
client_cmd=['taskset','-c','2,3',str(bindir/'rss_load_scenario_runner'),'--host','127.0.0.1','--port','19090','--scenario',scenario,'--clients','20','--rooms','4','--messages','300','--payload-bytes','256','--repeat','3','--rate-per-client','10','--max-in-flight','8','--timeout-seconds','60']
trace_cmd=['taskset','-c','2,3','tcpdump','-B','8192','-i','lo','-nn','-s','0','-U','-w',str(root/'traffic.pcap'),'tcp port 19090']
with open(root/'tcpdump.stderr','w') as te,open(root/'server.ndjson','w') as so,open(root/'server.stderr','w') as se:
 t=subprocess.Popen(trace_cmd,stderr=te,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
 try:
  deadline=time.monotonic()+10
  while 'listening on' not in (root/'tcpdump.stderr').read_text():
   if t.poll() is not None or time.monotonic()>deadline:raise RuntimeError('tcpdump startup')
   time.sleep(.02)
  p=subprocess.Popen(server_cmd,env=env,stdout=so,stderr=se)
  try:
   deadline=time.monotonic()+10
   while 'server_started' not in (root/'server.ndjson').read_text():
    if p.poll() is not None or time.monotonic()>deadline:raise RuntimeError('server startup')
    time.sleep(.02)
   cpu_before=pathlib.Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat').read_text();usage_before=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
   start=time.time_ns();r=subprocess.run(client_cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=270);end=time.time_ns()
   usage_after=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN);cpu_after=pathlib.Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat').read_text();server_stat=pathlib.Path('/proc',str(p.pid),'stat').read_text()
   (root/'client.stdout').write_text(r.stdout);(root/'client.stderr').write_text(r.stderr)
  finally:
   p.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM);p.wait(timeout=15)
 finally:
  time.sleep(1);t.send_signal(signal.SIGINT);t.wait(timeout=5)
meta={'label':label,'variant':variant,'server_command':server_cmd,'client_command':client_cmd,'capture_command':trace_cmd,'start_unix_ns':start,'end_unix_ns':end,'client_exit_code':r.returncode,'server_exit_code':p.returncode,'capture_exit_code':t.returncode,'client_cpu_seconds':usage_after.ru_utime+usage_after.ru_stime-usage_before.ru_utime-usage_before.ru_stime,'server_proc_stat':server_stat,'clock_ticks_per_second':os.sysconf('SC_CLK_TCK'),'cgroup_cpu_before':cpu_before,'cgroup_cpu_after':cpu_after,'sha256':{x:hashlib.sha256((bindir/x).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for x in ['rss_server','rss_load_scenario_runner']}}
(root/'meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2)+'\n');print(label,r.returncode,p.returncode,flush=True)

import json,pathlib,struct,hashlib,sys
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);result=[]
for p in sorted(root.glob('*/meta.json')):
 d=json.loads(p.read_text());base=p.parent
 d['client_stdout']=(base/'client.stdout').read_text();d['client_stderr']=(base/'client.stderr').read_text()
 d['rows']=[dict(x.split('=',1) for x in line.split()) for line in d['client_stdout'].splitlines() if line.startswith('run=')]
 if (base/'server.ndjson').exists():
  d['server_stdout']=[json.loads(line) for line in (base/'server.ndjson').read_text().splitlines()];d['server_stderr']=(base/'server.stderr').read_text();d['tcpdump_stderr']=(base/'tcpdump.stderr').read_text()
  stats={'captured_packets':0,'server_data_packets':0,'client_data_packets':0,'server_tcp_payload_bytes':0,'client_tcp_payload_bytes':0,'rst_packets':0}
  digest=hashlib.sha256()
  with (base/'traffic.pcap').open('rb') as f:
   header=f.read(24);digest.update(header);assert header[:4]==b'\xd4\xc3\xb2\xa1'
   while True:
    h=f.read(16)
    if not h:break
    sec,usec,n,orig=struct.unpack('<IIII',h);frame=f.read(n);digest.update(h);digest.update(frame);stats['captured_packets']+=1
    assert len(frame)==n
    if frame[12:14]!=b'\x08\x00':continue
    ip=frame[14:];ih=(ip[0]&15)*4
    if ip[9]!=6:continue
    tcp=ip[ih:];sport,dport=struct.unpack('!HH',tcp[:4]);th=(tcp[12]>>4)*4;payload_size=struct.unpack('!H',ip[2:4])[0]-ih-th
    if tcp[13]&4:stats['rst_packets']+=1
    if payload_size:
     side='server' if sport==19090 else 'client';stats[side+'_data_packets']+=1;stats[side+'_tcp_payload_bytes']+=payload_size
  d['packet_summary']=stats;d['pcap_sha256']=digest.hexdigest();ticks=d['server_proc_stat'].split();d['server_cpu_seconds']=(int(ticks[13])+int(ticks[14]))/d['clock_ticks_per_second']
 result.append(d)
 print(base.name, 'p99',[r['p99_ms'] for r in d['rows']], 'failed',[r['failed_clients'] for r in d['rows']], 'cpu',d.get('server_cpu_seconds'),d.get('client_cpu_seconds'), 'packets',d.get('packet_summary'))
(root/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps({'runs':result},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
